name: Stinky's Escape
summary: In the swamp, "Stinky" Ignatz is searching for bogbean leaves for a cook in Theramore. Critters have surrounded him, and he asks you to guard him while he looks for a plant. When he is done, Morgan Stern is waiting in Theramore.

sections.title: Surrounded
sections.body: "Stinky" Ignatz is glad to find someone who does not see him as a meal. Morgan Stern, a cook in Theramore, sent him to gather bogbean leaves for a new recipe. Ignatz guesses Stern finds them tasty. Now critters have surrounded him, and he asks you to guard his back while he searches for a bogbean plant.

sections.title: A Cook Waiting
sections.body: Morgan Stern, a cook in Theramore, is anxious. Ignatz went into the swamp a while ago and has not returned.

sections.title: Thanks from the Cook
sections.body: Morgan Stern says Ignatz brought the bogbean leaves and told him how you helped through trouble. To thank you, Stern will ask an uncle to give you a feast the next time you visit the Blue Recluse in Stormwind.
